overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows clear audience preference for mature relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife bonding and marital complexities, which generated breakout views (1,600+ to 1,700+ views). General sad shayari and family content (like siblings) underperformed significantly, indicating the core audience resonates more with romantic relationship reality than generic family bonds.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) vastly outperformed all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on married life realities, unsaid expectations, and emotional distance in modern relationships.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable psychological reality of relationships ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') secure steady mid-tier views (~392 views).
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational prompts that challenge everyday relationship assumptions.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on sisters ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 and 139 views.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone sibling emotional content and pivot focus entirely to romantic relationships and self-reflection.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract lines in favor of grounded, everyday relationship observations.
